svg.text: Fork, high visibility: thailand-1 at z15
For a handlebar screen in sunlight and older eyes (Julien, 2026-11-19), after the AdvOSM Garmin and DMD2 review. Contrast of each colour against the land in the legend column.
Before: OSM Carto based palette, z15 widths
High visibility: saturated fills, 1.5 x widths, dark band edge, road numbers
High vis 2 (the fork default): crimson-rose trunk, deeper orange, colour-blind safe
